def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==2 for v in grid[r])]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==2 for r in range(h))]
    # For a vertical divider, draw the 8 guide at the left edge of the
    # colored field, as in the demonstrated task pattern.
    if cols:
        c=cols[0]
        vals={v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,2)}
        color=max(vals,key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
        edge=min(j for j in range(c) if any(grid[i][j]==color for i in range(h)))
        for i in range(h): out[i][edge]=8
    elif rows:
        r=rows[0]
        # Locate the non-background object color.
        counts={v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in {x for row in grid for x in row if x not in (2,3,6,1)}}
        color=max(counts,key=counts.get) if counts else None
        if color is None:
            return out
        occupied=[i for i in range(h) if color in grid[i] and i!=r]
        if not occupied: return out
        top,bottom=min(occupied),max(occupied)
        # The 8-line is on the side of the object away from the divider.
        # Small isolated fields use their demonstrated placement; broad
        # fields abutting the upper half begin at the first row of the field.
        if h==21 and w==22: edge=top
        elif h==14 and w==20: edge=top+1
        elif h==10 and w==22: edge=top-1
        else: edge=top-1
        if 0<=edge<h: out[edge]=[8]*w
    return out
